title: Practice 1: под- and от-: up to, and away from

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Summer is coming to an end.
exercises.why: **подходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of подходить: imperfective (perfective partner: подойти).  Prefix **под-, подо-**: approach (к + dat.; до + gen).
**отвезёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of отвезти: perfective (imperfective partner: отвозить).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).

exercises.q: The ship is sailing at three.
exercises.why: **отплывает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of отплывать: imperfective (perfective partner: отплыть).  Prefix **от-, ото-**: withdrawal a short distance away (от + gen).
